title: Structural basis of DNA polymerase theta mediated DNA end joining.
authors: Li, Chuxuan; Zhu, Hanwen; Jin, Shikai; Maksoud, Leora M; Jain, Nikhil; Sun, Ji; Gao, Yang
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜结构和计算模拟揭示DNA聚合酶theta识别微同源DNA末端并介导MMEJ修复的机制，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作的结构与动态机理研究，但对象非转录因子，方法以实验结构为主、模拟为辅，对本课题有方法借鉴价值。
abstract: DNA polymerase theta (Pol theta) plays an essential role in the microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ) pathway for repairing DNA double-strand breaks. However, the mechanisms by which Pol theta recognizes microhomologous DNA ends and performs low-fidelity DNA synthesis remain unclear. Here, we present cryo-electron microscope structures of the polymerase domain of Lates calcarifer Pol theta with long and short duplex DNA at up to 2.4 A resolution. Interestingly, Pol theta binds to long and short DNA substrates similarly, with extensive interactions around the active site. Moreover, Pol theta shares a similar active site as high-fidelity A-family polymerases with its finger domain well-closed but differs in having hydrophilic residues surrounding the nascent base pair. Computational simulations and mutagenesis studies suggest that the unique insertion loops of Pol theta help to stabilize short DNA binding and assemble the active site for MMEJ repair. Taken together, our results illustrate the structural basis of Pol theta-mediated MMEJ.
abstract_zh: DNA聚合酶θ（Pol theta）在微同源介导的末端连接（MMEJ）通路中修复DNA双链断裂中发挥关键作用。然而，Pol theta识别微同源DNA末端并进行低保真DNA合成的机制仍不清楚。在此，我们展示了尖吻鲈（Lates calcarifer）Pol theta聚合酶结构域与长和短双链DNA复合物的冷冻电镜结构，分辨率高达2.4 Å。有趣的是，Pol theta以相似方式结合长和短DNA底物，在活性位点周围具有广泛的相互作用。此外，Pol theta与高保真A家族聚合酶共享相似的活性位点，其手指结构域紧密闭合，但不同之处在于其新生碱基对周围存在亲水性残基。计算模拟和突变研究提示，Pol theta独特的插入环有助于稳定短DNA结合并组装MMEJ修复的活性位点。综合来看，我们的结果阐明了Pol theta介导MMEJ的结构基础。
